description: Granting permanent appointments to the employees recruited on temporary, casual (on daily wages), substitute, contract or relief basis for Government institutions
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-04-27 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Taking into Consideration that approximately 9,800 employees recruited on temporary, casual (on daily wages), substitute, contract or relief basis are employed in the Public Service, Provincial Public Service, State Corporations, Statutory Boards and Institutions, the Hon. President proposed to grant permanent appointments to them through the budget proposal No. 33.11 for the year 2026. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development and the Minister of Public Administration, Provincial Councils and Local Government to issue the Circular containing the relevant provisions for granting permanent appointments to those employees, was approved by the Cabinet.
